data.name: Evangelista
data.gender_notes: Evangelista is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin word ‘evangelistia’ meaning ‘to bear good news’. In Christian tradition, an evangelist is an advocate, a teacher, and a preacher of the Gospel. The name Evangelista carries the meaning “Bringer of good news” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Evangelista usually hope their child will grow to embody bringer of good news and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Evangelista belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bringer of good news.”
